looks.label: Frame-cued sound
looks.technique: Each action frame carries sprite id, sub-sprite id, sub-frame, length and an audio id, so the sound lands on a frame (receipt LG-R18).

looks.label: Action slots
looks.technique: 72 action slots per sprite, each a list of frames (receipt LG-R19).

looks.label: Layered gear on one body
looks.technique: A clothing count and clothing id list on the sprite record (receipt LG-R20).

looks.label: Ambient and emote vocabulary
looks.technique: Taunt, wave, victory, stand, fishing, picking up, wand use, casting. Used as the idle and emote set (receipt LG-R11).

looks.label: Death presentation slot
looks.technique: A Dying action slot exists in the sword group row (receipt LG-R12). How and when it plays is not read.

looks.label: Eight facing directions
looks.technique: Eight heading labels precede the action table (receipt LG-R23).

originals.name: Frame-cued swing
originals.idea: The impact sound lands on the frame where the blade meets the target.
originals.keep: A sound cue on a specific frame; a per-action slot.
originals.change: Our action names and timing in seconds, not numbered slots.

originals.name: Layered gear on one body
originals.idea: A clothing list on one base body, so one silhouette reads as many outfits at 375 wide.
originals.keep: Base body plus a gear list.
originals.change: Our armour as rig plates, not sprite swaps.

originals.name: Weapon stance sets
originals.idea: Each weapon family carries its own walk, attack, hit and stand group.

originals.name: Class-keyed level-up line
originals.idea: A short line per class at each level makes the moment personal.

originals.name: Zone as a rectangle row
originals.idea: Name, map and bounds in one row keep zones as data.
originals.change: Ours carry spawn caps and biome fields (row 23 ruling).

originals.name: Ambient emote set
originals.idea: A small emote set (taunt, victory, wave) used as idle vocabulary.
